result:
Round 172 (V-3c-5a, the 10 px panel radius) **passes**. Every check that can run here was run in a real Chromium browser at 1440×900 and 1280×720, so `browserVerified` and `realVerified` are both true. One check is blocked: the Fake-Bearer 403 needs the backend, which isn't available in the cloud.

- **Source scope:** A's change is exactly what the task asked for. It adds one token line to `app.css` and changes one class on each of the six panel sites. The menu rows, the Overview, `Modal.tsx` and the purchase/auth files are untouched. Nothing in the source changed while I was testing.
- **Targeted tests:** I re-ran A's 21 test files: 362/362 pass, matching A. I did not re-run A's mutation checks (m227–m234); those remain A's claim.
- **Radius:** all six panels (Detail waveform box, group-reason box, video placeholder, video box compact and floating, Grid menu, Marker menu) measure 10 px on all four corners. Menu rows stay at 6 px and the Overview stays at 6 px. In the 4× crops the real video frame and the waveform peaks are cut by the rounded corners, with no square corner showing.
- **Layout:** the dock boxes and buttons match round 171 exactly (0.00 px) at both sizes. The full-page layout probe also matches round 171: no missing or added elements, zero movement, same contrast failures.
- **Function:** everything still works with a real mouse:
  - clicking in the waveform keeps the selection, and Set selection works;
  - the group reasons show the expected text;
  - the video expands to floating, moves 16 px with ArrowRight, plays, and returns to compact with focus on "Expand video";
  - the Grid menu changes the grid to 10 s;
  - deleting a marker through its menu removes it.
- **Premium access is not bypassed:** a fresh session with no credentials opens `/studio-lab` with the demo badge. `/studio/middle-east` shows "Sign in required" with no workspace and no audio, and the studio-token request returns 401.

Two new Low findings, both already present before this round (a radius change can't cause either):

- **C-R172-01:** at 1280×720, with an audio clip and the video clip selected together, the last line of the group-reason text runs 4 px past the box's bottom border. It fits at 1440. Fixing it needs a layout change in `ArrangementDetailPanel`, not a radius change.
- **C-R172-02:** pressing Set selection adds a fourth status line to the footer, and the Clip details panel jumps up 20 px with no transition. The selected-clip line already has space reserved for this reason; the time-selection line doesn't.

One note for B: after Escape, the Grid menu returns focus to the page body, not the opener. In a real browser, right-clicking the lane, which can't take focus, removes focus from the previous element before the menu opens. So the task's "focus back on its opener" wording can't be met with a real mouse. Either that wording or the unit test GM11, which skips the press, should be revisited.

Everything is in `tmp/studio-real-loop/`; scripts, screenshots and measurements are in `c-round-172/`.
